info.name: Generates a Scouting Report for an organization.

params.name: orgId
params.description: CB Insights organization ID; only active companies are eligible

items.docs: Due to the substantial processing involved in generating a Scouting Report, this call may take several minutes. If you'd like to stream the report as it's generated, please use the `/v2/organizations/{orgId}/scoutingreportstream` endpoint. When present, Mosaic scores always represent version 2.1 of the model.

info.name: Generates a Scouting Report for an organization and delivers it as a stream.

params.name: orgId
params.description: CB Insights organization ID; only active companies are eligible

items.docs: Delivered as a series of chunks, where each chunk is a JSON object, with data progressively added in each new chunk. If a server-side error occurs mid-stream, an object will be written containing the key `"error"` and you will not be charged a credit. When present, Mosaic scores always represent version 2.1 of the model.
